title: 第9章 再入迷雾第10章 意外之喜
slug: 迷雾求生从流民开始的领主之路
content_zh:
“家里人……”
听到这个问题，莉娜原本畏缩的表情忽然松动了一下。
那双总是低垂、盛满恐惧的眼睛里，第一次有了不一样的光彩……
那是一种混合着怀念与温暖的微光，尽管很快就被现实的阴翳覆盖。
她抱着膝盖的手稍稍放松，身体微微前倾，像是要靠近记忆中那团不存在的暖意。
“我来自白河镇附近的枫叶村。”
她的声音很轻，却比之前多了一丝生气，
“家里有父亲、母亲，还有一个总嫌我碍事的哥哥。”
她的嘴角不自觉地扬起一个极细微的弧度。
“我们家不算富，但有自己的田，一匹叫‘灰蹄’的老马。父亲总说它年轻时跑得可快了，可我记事起它就总是慢悠悠的。”
她顿了顿，眼神飘向虚空中的某一点，
“春天播种的时候，哥哥会把我抱到马背上坐着，他牵着马，父亲在后面扶着犁。母亲会提着装了麦饼和水的篮子，等在田埂那头……”
“夏天晚上，我们会在院子里乘凉。父亲会讲他年轻时跑商见过的怪事，虽然我觉得大半是他瞎编的。”
“哥哥会用草叶编蚱蜢给我，虽然总是编得歪歪扭扭……”
她的声音越来越低，最后几乎成了呢喃，
“母亲做的黑莓酱……是整个秋天最好吃的东西。”
那画面太具体，太鲜活，带着炊烟的温度和阳光的气息，与此刻冰冷、死寂、被灰雾笼罩的世界格格不入。
亚修静静地听着，没有打断，等她停顿下来，这才轻声问道
“那……你怎么会到了这儿呢？”
莉娜眼里的光，像被风吹熄的烛火，倏地暗了下去。

“不……不知道。”
她摇了摇头，双手重新抱紧自己，仿佛突然感到寒冷，
“只记得那天下午，大地突然开始摇晃，桌上的陶罐滚到地上摔碎了……然后，天空像是被撕开了一道巨大的口子。”
她的身体微微发抖。
“刺眼的光，还有轰隆隆的声音，到处都在塌。”
“我吓坏了，想往外跑去找母亲……然后……然后就在这里了。四周全是雾，没有村子，没有田，没有家。”
她抬起头，看向亚修，那双眼睛里此刻充满了迷茫和一丝微弱的、近乎乞求的希望：
“亚修大人……我们，我们还有可能……回家吗？”
回家？
亚修心里泛起一阵苦涩。
连这里是何处、甚至是否还在同一个世界都无从知晓，又谈何回家？
他的家，又在哪里呢？
但看着莉娜眼中那点摇摇欲坠的期待，他到了嘴边的话咽了回去。
“会有机会的。”
亚修的声音比自己预想的要平稳，
content_en:
"Family members..."
Hearing this question, Lina's cowering expression suddenly relaxed.
Those eyes that were always downcast and full of fear had a different light for the first time...
It was a glimmer of nostalgia and warmth, although it was quickly covered by the shadow of reality.
She relaxed her hands holding her knees slightly and leaned forward slightly, as if to get closer to the non-existent warmth in her memory.
"I'm from Maple Leaf Village near Baihe Town."
Her voice was very soft, but a little more alive than before.
"I have a father, a mother, and an older brother who always thinks I'm in the way."
The corners of her mouth unconsciously raised a very slight arc.
"Our family is not rich, but we have our own fields and an old horse named Gray Hoof. My father always said that it ran very fast when it was young, but it has always been slow as long as I can remember."
She paused, her eyes drifting to a certain point in the void,
"When sowing in the spring, my brother would carry me on the back of a horse and sit on it. He would lead the horse, and my father would hold the plow behind. My mother would wait at the other end of the field with a basket filled with wheat cakes and water..."
"On summer evenings, we would enjoy the shade in the yard. My father would tell stories about strange things he had seen when he was a businessman when he was young, although I think he made most of them up."
"Brother will make grasshoppers for me out of blades of grass, although they are always twisted..."
Her voice became lower and lower, until it was almost a whisper,
"My mother's blackberry jam...is the most delicious thing all fall."
The picture was too specific and vivid, with the warmth of cooking smoke and the breath of sunshine, and was incompatible with the cold, dead, and gray fog-shrouded world at the moment.
Ya Xiu listened quietly without interrupting. When she paused, he asked softly
"Then...how did you get here?"
The light in Lina's eyes suddenly dimmed like a candle blown out by the wind.
"No...don't know."
She shook her head and hugged herself tightly with her hands again, as if she suddenly felt cold,
"I just remember that afternoon, the earth suddenly began to shake, and the clay pot on the table rolled to the ground and broke... Then, it seemed like a huge hole was torn open in the sky."
Her body was shaking slightly.
"Dazzling light, rumbling sounds, and collapse everywhere."
"I was so frightened that I wanted to run out to find my mother...and then...and then I was here. There was fog all around. There was no village, no fields, and no home."
She raised her head and looked at Ash, her eyes filled with confusion and a faint, almost begging hope:
"Master Ash...we, is it possible for us...to go home?"
Go home?
Ash felt bitter in his heart.
If you don't even know where this is or whether it's even in the same world, how can you go home?
Where is his home?
But seeing the shaky expectation in Lina's eyes, he swallowed the words that came to his lips.
"There will be a chance."
Ash's voice was smoother than he expected;
